requirement.value: Dancer, Fury, Cook (Gourmet) or Traveller (Wayfarer) mastery

system.description: Inventory action + 3 IP: consume an alcoholic drink and become drunk. While drunk your Dexterity counts as one die size higher, to a maximum of d12, and when an enemy misses you, you deal damage equal to your current Dexterity die — physical, or the type a dance changed your damage to. It ends at the end of the scene, if you die or fall unconscious, if you take a potion or delicacy that clears a status, or if you are Cleansed. How you play it is yours to choose: genuinely drunk, or a fighter affecting drunkenness to make himself hard to read. The mechanics are identical and the table does not have to agree. The die raise obeys the standing rule — raises never stack, d12 is the ceiling.
